from solution import Service


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


def setup(**kw):
    c = Clock()
    s = Service(c, **kw)
    s.register_user("ann", "member")
    s.register_user("bob", "member")
    s.register_user("sue", "staff")
    for i in range(5):
        s.add_item("i%d" % i, "same")
    return c, s


def test_register_validation():
    s = Service(Clock())
    assert s.register_user("", "member")[0] == 400
    assert s.register_user("a", "admin")[0] == 400
    assert s.register_user(1, "member")[0] == 400
    assert s.register_user("a", None)[0] == 400
    assert s.register_user("a", "member")[0] == 201
    assert s.register_user("a", "staff")[0] == 409


def test_add_item_validation():
    s = Service(Clock())
    assert s.add_item("", "x")[0] == 400
    assert s.add_item("a", "")[0] == 400
    assert s.add_item("a", "x")[0] == 201
    assert s.add_item("b", "x")[0] == 201
    assert s.add_item("a", "y")[0] == 409


def test_checkout_order_and_limits():
    c, s = setup()
    assert s.checkout("zed", "nope")[0] == 404
    assert s.checkout("ann", "nope")[0] == 404
    assert s.checkout("ann", "i0") == (200, {"loan_id": 1, "due_at": 1007.0})
    assert s.checkout("bob", "i0")[0] == 409
    s.checkout("ann", "i1")
    s.checkout("ann", "i2")
    assert s.checkout("ann", "i3")[0] == 422
    # item busy takes precedence over limit
    assert s.checkout("ann", "i0")[0] == 409
    s.return_loan("ann", 1)
    assert s.checkout("ann", "i3")[0] == 200


def test_return_rules():
    c, s = setup()
    _, b = s.checkout("ann", "i0")
    lid = b["loan_id"]
    assert s.return_loan("ann", 99)[0] == 404
    assert s.return_loan("bob", lid)[0] == 403
    assert s.item_status("i0") == (200, {"available": False, "loan_id": lid})
    assert s.return_loan("sue", lid) == (200, {"item_id": "i0"})
    assert s.return_loan("ann", lid)[0] == 409
    assert s.item_status("i0") == (200, {"available": True, "loan_id": None})


def test_renew_rules():
    c, s = setup()
    _, b = s.checkout("ann", "i0")
    lid = b["loan_id"]
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", 5)[0] == 404
    assert s.renew_loan("bob", lid)[0] == 403
    assert s.renew_loan("sue", lid) == (200, {"due_at": 1014.0})
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", lid) == (200, {"due_at": 1021.0})
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", lid)[0] == 422
    c.t = 1022.0
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", lid)[0] == 409  # overdue beats limit
    s.return_loan("ann", lid)
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", lid)[0] == 409


def test_renew_exactly_due_ok():
    c, s = setup()
    _, b = s.checkout("ann", "i0")
    c.t = 1007.0
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", b["loan_id"])[0] == 200


def test_config():
    c, s = setup(max_loans=1, max_renewals=0, loan_period=2.0)
    _, b = s.checkout("ann", "i0")
    assert b["due_at"] == 1002.0
    assert s.checkout("ann", "i1")[0] == 422
    assert s.renew_loan("ann", b["loan_id"])[0] == 422


def test_list_loans():
    c, s = setup()
    assert s.list_loans("zed")[0] == 404
    assert s.list_loans("ann") == (200, [])
    s.checkout("ann", "i0")
    s.checkout("bob", "i1")
    s.checkout("ann", "i2")
    s.return_loan("ann", 1)
    st, l = s.list_loans("ann")
    assert [x["loan_id"] for x in l] == [1, 3]
    assert [x["status"] for x in l] == ["returned", "active"]
    assert l[0]["item_id"] == "i0"


def test_item_status_404():
    s = Service(Clock())
    assert s.item_status("x")[0] == 404

import pytest
from hypothesis import given, settings, strategies as st

from solution import Service


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=100.0):
        self.t = float(t)

    def now(self):
        return self.t

    def advance(self, dt):
        self.t += dt


def make(t=100.0, **kw):
    c = Clock(t)
    s = Service(c, **kw)
    assert s.register_user("alice", "member")[0] == 201
    assert s.register_user("bob", "member")[0] == 201
    assert s.register_user("carol", "staff")[0] == 201
    for i in ("i1", "i2", "i3", "i4", "i5"):
        assert s.add_item(i, "name-" + i)[0] == 201
    return s, c


# ---------------- REQ-1 register_user ----------------

def test_register_user_success():
    """register_user with valid id and role must return 201 and the user_id/role body."""
    s = Service(Clock())
    out = s.register_user("u", "member")
    assert out == (201, {"user_id": "u", "role": "member"}), f"input=('u','member') output={out!r}"
    out = s.register_user("v", "staff")
    assert out == (201, {"user_id": "v", "role": "staff"}), f"input=('v','staff') output={out!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("uid,role", [
    ("", "member"), (None, "member"), (5, "member"), ("u", ""), ("u", None),
    ("u", "admin"), ("u", "Member"), ("u", "STAFF"), ("u", 1), (b"u", "member"),
])
def test_register_user_invalid_400(uid, role):
    """register_user with an invalid user_id or role must return 400."""
    s = Service(Clock())
    out = s.register_user(uid, role)
    assert out[0] == 400, f"input={(uid, role)!r} output={out!r}"


def test_register_user_duplicate_409():
    """register_user for an existing user_id must return 409."""
    s = Service(Clock())
    assert s.register_user("u", "member")[0] == 201
    out = s.register_user("u", "member")
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('u','member') twice output={out!r}"
    out = s.register_user("u", "staff")
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('u','staff') after member output={out!r}"


def test_register_user_invalid_does_not_create():
    """A rejected register_user must not create the user."""
    s = Service(Clock())
    assert s.register_user("u", "admin")[0] == 400
    out = s.list_loans("u")
    assert out[0] == 404, f"input=list_loans('u') after rejected register output={out!r}"
    out = s.register_user("u", "member")
    assert out[0] == 201, f"input=('u','member') output={out!r}"


@given(st.text(min_size=1), st.sampled_from(["member", "staff"]))
def test_register_user_property(uid, role):
    """Any non-empty str id with a valid role registers once (201) and then conflicts (409)."""
    s = Service(Clock())
    out = s.register_user(uid, role)
    assert out == (201, {"user_id": uid, "role": role}), f"input={(uid, role)!r} output={out!r}"
    out = s.register_user(uid, role)
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input={(uid, role)!r} repeated output={out!r}"


@given(st.one_of(st.none(), st.integers(), st.floats(), st.lists(st.integers()), st.booleans()))
def test_register_user_non_str_id_property(uid):
    """A non-str user_id must be rejected with 400."""
    s = Service(Clock())
    out = s.register_user(uid, "member")
    assert out[0] == 400, f"input={uid!r} output={out!r}"


# ---------------- REQ-2 add_item ----------------

def test_add_item_success():
    """add_item with valid id and name must return 201 with item_id and name."""
    s = Service(Clock())
    out = s.add_item("i", "Drill")
    assert out == (201, {"item_id": "i", "name": "Drill"}), f"input=('i','Drill') output={out!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("iid,name", [
    ("", "n"), (None, "n"), (3, "n"), ("i", ""), ("i", None), ("i", 7), ("", ""),
])
def test_add_item_invalid_400(iid, name):
    """add_item with an invalid item_id or name must return 400."""
    s = Service(Clock())
    out = s.add_item(iid, name)
    assert out[0] == 400, f"input={(iid, name)!r} output={out!r}"


def test_add_item_duplicate_409():
    """add_item for an existing item_id must return 409 even with a different name."""
    s = Service(Clock())
    assert s.add_item("i", "A")[0] == 201
    out = s.add_item("i", "A")
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('i','A') repeated output={out!r}"
    out = s.add_item("i", "B")
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('i','B') output={out!r}"


def test_add_item_same_name_distinct_ids_ok():
    """Two distinct items may share the same name."""
    s = Service(Clock())
    assert s.add_item("a", "Same")[0] == 201
    out = s.add_item("b", "Same")
    assert out == (201, {"item_id": "b", "name": "Same"}), f"input=('b','Same') output={out!r}"


@given(st.text(min_size=1), st.text(min_size=1))
def test_add_item_property(iid, name):
    """Any non-empty str id and name adds once (201) then conflicts (409)."""
    s = Service(Clock())
    out = s.add_item(iid, name)
    assert out == (201, {"item_id": iid, "name": name}), f"input={(iid, name)!r} output={out!r}"
    out = s.add_item(iid, name)
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input={(iid, name)!r} repeated output={out!r}"


# ---------------- REQ-3 checkout ----------------

def test_checkout_success_body_and_due():
    """checkout must return 200 with loan_id 1 and due_at = now + loan_period."""
    s, c = make(t=100.0)
    out = s.checkout("alice", "i1")
    assert out == (200, {"loan_id": 1, "due_at": 107.0}), f"input=('alice','i1') output={out!r}"
    assert isinstance(out[1]["loan_id"], int) and isinstance(out[1]["due_at"], float), \
        f"input=('alice','i1') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_custom_loan_period():
    """checkout due_at must equal clock.now() + the configured loan_period."""
    s, c = make(t=10.5, loan_period=2.5)
    out = s.checkout("alice", "i1")
    assert out == (200, {"loan_id": 1, "due_at": 13.0}), f"input=('alice','i1') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_sequential_ids_across_users():
    """Loan ids must be sequential starting at 1 across all users."""
    s, c = make()
    ids = [s.checkout("alice", "i1")[1]["loan_id"],
           s.checkout("bob", "i2")[1]["loan_id"],
           s.checkout("alice", "i3")[1]["loan_id"]]
    assert ids == [1, 2, 3], f"output ids={ids!r}"


def test_checkout_unknown_user_404():
    """checkout for an unregistered user must return 404."""
    s, c = make()
    out = s.checkout("nobody", "i1")
    assert out[0] == 404, f"input=('nobody','i1') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_unknown_item_404():
    """checkout for an item not in the catalog must return 404."""
    s, c = make()
    out = s.checkout("alice", "zzz")
    assert out[0] == 404, f"input=('alice','zzz') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_item_on_loan_409():
    """checkout of an item with an active loan must return 409."""
    s, c = make()
    assert s.checkout("alice", "i1")[0] == 200
    for u in ("bob", "alice", "carol"):
        out = s.checkout(u, "i1")
        assert out[0] == 409, f"input=({u!r},'i1') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_limit_422_default():
    """With default max_loans a fourth simultaneous checkout must return 422."""
    s, c = make()
    for i in ("i1", "i2", "i3"):
        assert s.checkout("alice", i)[0] == 200
    out = s.checkout("alice", "i4")
    assert out[0] == 422, f"input=('alice','i4') output={out!r}"
    out = s.item_status("i4")
    assert out == (200, {"available": True, "loan_id": None}), f"input=i4 output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_check_order_user_before_item():
    """An unregistered user must get 404 even if the item is on loan or at limit."""
    s, c = make(max_loans=1)
    assert s.checkout("alice", "i1")[0] == 200
    out = s.checkout("nobody", "i1")
    assert out[0] == 404, f"input=('nobody','i1') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_check_order_item_on_loan_before_limit():
    """A checkout of an item on loan by a user at the limit must return 409, not 422."""
    s, c = make(max_loans=1)
    assert s.checkout("alice", "i1")[0] == 200
    out = s.checkout("alice", "i1")
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('alice','i1') at limit output={out!r}"
    out = s.checkout("bob", "i1")
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('bob','i1') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_check_order_unknown_item_before_limit():
    """An unknown item must give 404 even when the user is at the loan limit."""
    s, c = make(max_loans=1)
    assert s.checkout("alice", "i1")[0] == 200
    out = s.checkout("alice", "zzz")
    assert out[0] == 404, f"input=('alice','zzz') at limit output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_max_loans_zero_always_422():
    """With max_loans=0 every checkout by a registered user of an available item must return 422."""
    s, c = make(max_loans=0)
    for u in ("alice", "carol"):
        out = s.checkout(u, "i1")
        assert out[0] == 422, f"input=({u!r},'i1') max_loans=0 output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_failures_do_not_consume_loan_ids():
    """Failed checkouts create no loan, so the next successful loan_id follows the last created one."""
    s, c = make(max_loans=1)
    assert s.checkout("alice", "i1")[1]["loan_id"] == 1
    assert s.checkout("alice", "i2")[0] == 422
    assert s.checkout("bob", "i1")[0] == 409
    assert s.checkout("nobody", "i3")[0] == 404
    out = s.checkout("bob", "i2")
    assert out == (200, {"loan_id": 2, "due_at": 107.0}), f"input=('bob','i2') output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_returned_loans_do_not_count_toward_limit():
    """Returned loans must not count toward max_loans."""
    s, c = make(max_loans=1)
    st_, body = s.checkout("alice", "i1")
    assert s.return_loan("alice", body["loan_id"])[0] == 200
    out = s.checkout("alice", "i2")
    assert out[0] == 200, f"input=('alice','i2') after return output={out!r}"


def test_checkout_configured_limit():
    """A user may hold exactly max_loans active loans and no more."""
    s, c = make(max_loans=2)
    assert s.checkout("alice", "i1")[0] == 200
    assert s.checkout("alice", "i2")[0] == 200
    out = s.checkout("alice", "i3")
    assert out[0] == 422, f"input=('alice','i3') max_loans=2 output={out!r}"
    out = s.checkout("bob", "i3")
    assert out[0] == 200, f"input=('bob','i3') output={out!r}"


@given(n=st.integers(0, 6))
def test_checkout_limit_property(n):
    """Exactly max_loans checkouts succeed for one user, and the next returns 422."""
    c = Clock()
    s = Service(c, max_loans=n)
    s.register_user("u", "member")
    for k in range(n + 1):
        s.add_item(f"i{k}", "x")
    for k in range(n):
        out = s.checkout("u", f"i{k}")
        assert out[0] == 200, f"max_loans={n} k={k} output={out!r}"
    out = s.checkout("u", f"i{n}")
    assert out[0] == 422, f"max_loans={n} extra checkout output={out!r}"


@given(now=st.floats(0, 1e6, allow_nan=False), period=st.floats(0.001, 1e4, allow_nan=False))
def test_checkout_due_at_property(now, period):
    """checkout due_at must equal clock.now() + loan_period."""
    c = Clock(now)
    s = Service(c, loan_period=period)
    s.register_user("u", "member")
    s.add_item("i", "n")
    out = s.checkout("u", "i")
    assert out[0] == 200 and out[1]["due_at"] == now + period, \
        f"input=now={now!r},period={period!r} output={out!r}"


# ---------------- REQ-4 return_loan ----------------

def test_return_success_frees_item():
    """return_loan by the owner must return 200 with item_id and make the item available."""
    s, c = make()
    lid = s.checkout("alice", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    out = s.return_loan("alice", lid)
    assert out == (200, {"item_id": "i1"}), f"input=('alice',{lid}) output={out!r}"
    out = s.item_status("i1")
    assert out == (200, {"available": True, "loan_id": None}), f"input=i1 output={out!r}"


def test_return_unknown_loan_404():
    """return_loan for an unknown loan_id must return 404."""
    s, c = make()
    for u in ("alice", "carol"):
        out = s.return_loan(u, 999)
        assert out[0] == 404, f"input=({u!r},999) output={out!r}"


def test_return_unknown_loan_before_ownership():
    """An unknown loan must give 404 for a member regardless of ownership."""
    s, c = make()
    s.checkout("bob", "i1")
    out = s.return_loan("alice", 2)
    assert out[0] == 404, f"input=('alice',2) output={out!r}"


def test_return_non_owner_member_403():
    """A member returning another user's loan must get 403 and the loan stays active."""
    s, c = make()
    lid = s.checkout("alice", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    out = s.return_loan("bob", lid)
    assert out[0] == 403, f"input=('bob',{lid}) output={out!r}"
    out = s.item_status("i1")
    assert out == (200, {"available": False, "loan_id": lid}), f"input=i1 output={out!r}"


def test_return_staff_can_return_any_loan():
    """A staff user may return any user's loan."""
    s, c = make()
    lid = s.checkout("alice", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    out = s.return_loan("carol", lid)
    assert out == (200, {"item_id": "i1"}), f"input=('carol',{lid}) output={out!r}"
    out = s.list_loans("alice")
    assert out[0] == 200 and out[1][0]["status"] == "returned", f"input=alice output={out!r}"


def test_return_already_returned_409():
    """Returning an already returned loan must return 409."""
    s, c = make()
    lid = s.checkout("alice", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    assert s.return_loan("alice", lid)[0] == 200
    out = s.return_loan("alice", lid)
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('alice',{lid}) twice output={out!r}"
    out = s.return_loan("carol", lid)
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('carol',{lid}) staff on returned output={out!r}"


def test_return_ownership_checked_before_returned_status():
    """A non-owner member must get 403 (not 409) for an already returned loan."""
    s, c = make()
    lid = s.checkout("alice", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    assert s.return_loan("alice", lid)[0] == 200
    out = s.return_loan("bob", lid)
    assert out[0] == 403, f"input=('bob',{lid}) returned loan output={out!r}"


def test_return_overdue_allowed():
    """Returning an overdue loan must still succeed."""
    s, c = make()
    lid = s.checkout("alice", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    c.advance(1000.0)
    out = s.return_loan("alice", lid)
    assert out == (200, {"item_id": "i1"}), f"input=('alice',{lid}) overdue output={out!r}"


def test_return_then_checkout_again_new_loan_id():
    """After a return the item can be checked out again and gets a new loan_id."""
    s, c = make()
    lid = s.checkout("alice", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    s.return_loan("alice", lid)
    out = s.checkout("bob", "i1")
    assert out[0] == 200 and out[1]["loan_id"] == lid + 1, f"input=('bob','i1') output={out!r}"
    out = s.item_status("i1")
    assert out == (200, {"available": False, "loan_id": lid + 1}), f"input=i1 output={out!r}"


# ---------------- REQ-5 renew_loan ----------------

def test_renew_success_extends_from_due_at():
    """renew_loan must set due_at = old due_at + loan_period (not now + period)."""
    s, c = make(t=100.0)
    lid = s.checkout("alice", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    c.advance(3.0)
    out = s.renew_loan("alice", lid)
    assert out == (200, {"due_at": 114.0}), f"input=('alice',{lid}) output={out!r}"
    out = s.list_loans("alice")
    assert out[1][0]["due_at"] == 114.0 and out[1][0]["renewals_used"] == 1, \
        f"input=alice output={out!r}"


def test_renew_unknown_loan_404():
    """renew_loan for an unknown loan_id must return 404."""
    s, c = make()
    out = s.renew_loan("alice", 42)
    assert out[0] == 404, f"input=('alice',42) output={out!r}"


def test_renew_non_owner_member_403():
    """A member renewing another user's loan must get 403."""
    s, c = make()
    lid = s.checkout("alice", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    out = s.renew_loan("bob", lid)
    assert out[0] == 403, f"input=('bob',{lid}) output={out!r}"
    out = s.list_loans("alice")
    assert out[1][0]["renewals_used"] == 0 and out[1][0]["due_at"] == 107.0, f"input=alice output={out!r}"


def test_renew_staff_can_renew_any_loan():
    """A staff user may renew any user's loan."""
    s, c = make()
    lid = s.checkout("alice", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    out = s.renew_loan("carol", lid)
    assert out == (200, {"due_at": 114.0}), f"input=('carol',{lid}) output={out!r}"


def test_renew_returned_409():
    """Renewing a returned loan must return 409."""
    s, c = make()
    lid = s.checkout("alice", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    s.return_loan("alice", lid)
    out = s.renew_loan("alice", lid)
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('alice',{lid}) returned output={out!r}"


def test_renew_returned_and_overdue_409_for_owner_403_for_other():
    """A returned loan gives 409 to its owner even if overdue and 403 to a non-owner member."""
    s, c = make()
    lid = s.checkout("alice", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    s.return_loan("alice", lid)
    c.advance(100.0)
    assert s.renew_loan("alice", lid)[0] == 409
    out = s.renew_loan("bob", lid)
    assert out[0] == 403, f"input=('bob',{lid}) returned loan output={out!r}"


def test_renew_exactly_at_due_allowed():
    """Renewal at now == due_at is not overdue and must succeed."""
    s, c = make(t=100.0)
    lid = s.checkout("alice", "i1")[1]["loan_id"]
    c.t = 107.0
    out = s.renew_loan("alice", lid)
    assert out == (200, {"due_at": 114.0}), f"input=('alice',{lid}) at due output={out!r}"

class Model:
    def __init__(self, clock, max_loans, max_renewals, period):
        self.c, self.ml, self.mr, self.p = clock, max_loans, max_renewals, period
        self.roles = {"u0": "staff", "u1": "member", "u2": "member"}
        self.items = {"i0", "i1", "i2", "i3"}
        self.loans = {}
        self.on_loan = {}
        self.next = 1

    def checkout(self, u, i):
        if u not in self.roles:
            return 404
        if i not in self.items:
            return 404
        if i in self.on_loan:
            return 409
        active = sum(1 for l in self.loans.values() if l["user"] == u and l["status"] == "active")
        if active >= self.ml:
            return 422
        lid = self.next
        self.next += 1
        due = self.c.now() + self.p
        self.loans[lid] = dict(user=u, item=i, due=due, ren=0, status="active")
        self.on_loan[i] = lid
        return (200, {"loan_id": lid, "due_at": due})

    def _access(self, u, lid):
        if lid not in self.loans:
            return 404
        l = self.loans[lid]
        if l["user"] != u and self.roles[u] != "staff":
            return 403
        return None

    def return_loan(self, u, lid):
        r = self._access(u, lid)
        if r:
            return r
        l = self.loans[lid]
        if l["status"] == "returned":
            return 409
        l["status"] = "returned"
        del self.on_loan[l["item"]]
        return (200, {"item_id": l["item"]})

    def renew(self, u, lid):
        r = self._access(u, lid)
        if r:
            return r
        l = self.loans[lid]
        if l["status"] == "returned":
            return 409
        if self.c.now() > l["due"]:
            return 409
        if l["ren"] >= self.mr:
            return 422
        l["due"] += self.p
        l["ren"] += 1
        return (200, {"due_at": l["due"]})

    def list_loans(self, u):
        return (200, [
            {"loan_id": k, "item_id": l["item"], "due_at": l["due"],
             "renewals_used": l["ren"], "status": l["status"]}
            for k, l in sorted(self.loans.items()) if l["user"] == u
        ])

    def item_status(self, i):
        lid = self.on_loan.get(i)
        return (200, {"available": lid is None, "loan_id": lid})


def _cmp(out, exp, ctx):
    if isinstance(exp, int):
        assert out[0] == exp, f"input={ctx!r} output={out!r} expected status={exp}"
    else:

    history = []
    for kind, ui, ii, lid, k in ops:

            c.advance(float(x))
            now += x
            continue
        if kind == "checkout":

            else:

                              "status": "active"}
                exp = (200, {"loan_id": nxt, "due_at": now + period})
                nxt += 1
            out = s.checkout(x, y)
        elif kind in ("return", "renew"):
            l = loans.get(y)
            if l is None:
                exp = (404, None)
            elif l["user_id"] != x and roles[x] != "staff":
                exp = (403, None)
            elif l["status"] == "returned":
                exp = (409, None)
            elif kind == "return":
                l["status"] = "returned"
                exp = (200, {"item_id": l["item_id"]})
            elif now > l["due_at"]:

            elif l["renewals_used"] >= max_renewals:
                exp = (422, None)
            else:
                l["due_at"] += period
                l["renewals_used"] += 1
                exp = (200, {"due_at": l["due_at"]})
            out = s.return_loan(x, y) if kind == "return" else s.renew_loan(x, y)
        elif kind == "list":
            if x not in roles:
                exp = (404, None)
            else:
                exp = (200, [
                    {k: v for k, v in loans[i].items() if k != "user_id"}
                    for i in sorted(loans) if loans[i]["user_id"] == x])
            out = s.list_loans(x)
        else:

                exp = (404, None)
            else:

                       if l["item_id"] == x and l["status"] == "active"]
                exp = (200, {"available": not act, "loan_id": act[0] if act else None})
            out = s.item_status(x)
        assert out == exp, f"ops={history!r} output={out!r} expected={exp!r}"

class Model:
    """Reference model written directly from the specification."""

    def __init__(self, clock, ml, mr, lp):
        self.clock, self.ml, self.mr, self.lp = clock, ml, mr, lp
        self.users, self.items, self.loans, self.next_id = {}, {}, {}, 1

    @staticmethod
    def valid(x):
        return isinstance(x, str) and x != ""

    def reg(self, uid, role):
        if not self.valid(uid) or role not in ("member", "staff"):
            return 400, None
        if uid in self.users:
            return 409, None
        self.users[uid] = role
        return 201, {"user_id": uid, "role": role}

    def item(self, iid, name):
        if not self.valid(iid) or not self.valid(name):
            return 400, None
        if iid in self.items:
            return 409, None
        self.items[iid] = name
        return 201, {"item_id": iid, "name": name}

    def active_for_item(self, iid):
        for lid, l in self.loans.items():
            if l["item"] == iid and l["status"] == "active":
                return lid
        return None

    def co(self, uid, iid):
        if uid not in self.users:
            return 404, None
        if iid not in self.items:
            return 404, None
        if self.active_for_item(iid) is not None:
            return 409, None
        n = sum(1 for l in self.loans.values() if l["user"] == uid and l["status"] == "active")
        if n >= self.ml:
            return 422, None
        lid = self.next_id
        self.next_id += 1
        due = self.clock.now() + self.lp
        self.loans[lid] = {"user": uid, "item": iid, "due": due, "ren": 0, "status": "active"}
        return 200, {"loan_id": lid, "due_at": due}

    def _access(self, uid, lid):
        if lid not in self.loans:
            return 404
        l = self.loans[lid]
        if l["user"] != uid and self.users.get(uid) != "staff":
            return 403
        return None

    def ret(self, uid, lid):
        e = self._access(uid, lid)
        if e:
            return e, None
        l = self.loans[lid]
        if l["status"] == "returned":
            return 409, None
        l["status"] = "returned"
        return 200, {"item_id": l["item"]}

    def ren(self, uid, lid):
        e = self._access(uid, lid)
        if e:
            return e, None
        l = self.loans[lid]
        if l["status"] == "returned":
            return 409, None
        if self.clock.now() > l["due"]:
            return 409, None
        if l["ren"] >= self.mr:
            return 422, None
        l["due"] = l["due"] + self.lp
        l["ren"] += 1
        return 200, {"due_at": l["due"]}

    def lst(self, uid):
        if uid not in self.users:
            return 404, None
        out = [{"loan_id": lid, "item_id": l["item"], "due_at": l["due"],
                "renewals_used": l["ren"], "status": l["status"]}
               for lid, l in sorted(self.loans.items()) if l["user"] == uid]
        return 200, out

    def stat(self, iid):
        if iid not in self.items:
            return 404, None
        a = self.active_for_item(iid)
        return 200, {"available": a is None, "loan_id": a}
